meta.title: Article Display Options Hierarchy
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Article Display Options Hierarchy".

steps.title: Olympus Solar Calculator
steps.text: Calculate the position of the sun for any place and time.

UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Article Display Options Hierarchy', 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item', '

Many display options of an article, such as showing its author, can be set in three places: the Global Configuration, the menu item, and the article itself. In this tour you see which one wins.

The playground already has the category Sundial Software with two articles, Sun Daze Companion and Olympus Solar Calculator, and a menu item Sundial Software Blog that shows them as a blog.

This tour follows the tutorial 10.3 Article Display Options Hierarchy of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_config","com_menus","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 10.3 Article Display Options Hierarchy', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'System', '

In the menu on the left, click System.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_cpanel&view=cpanel&dashboard=system"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'Setup › Global Configuration', '

In the box Setup, click Global Configuration.

', 2, 'bottom', '.com_cpanel #content a[href="index.php?option=com_config"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_cpanel&view=cpanel&dashboard=system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'Component › Articles', '

The options of the articles are on their own page. Under Component on the left, click Articles.

', 3, 'right', '.com_config #sidebar-nav a[href="index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'Author', '

On the tab Articles, Author is set to Show. Articles and menu items use this global setting unless they set their own.

', 4, 'top', '.com_config.view-component .control-group:has(#jform_show_author)', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'The author shows', '

Look at your site with this button: it opens in a new tab (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar), or reload that tab.

Click Sundial Software Blog in the main menu: under each article it says Written by. Open an article: the author shows there too.

Come back to this tab and click Next.

', 5, 'bottom', '#header a.header-item-content[target="_blank"]', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'Author: Hide', '

Set Author to Hide. Then click Next.

', 6, 'top', '.com_config.view-component .control-group:has(#jform_show_author)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'Save', '

Click Save.

', 7, 'bottom', '.com_config.view-component #toolbar-apply .button-apply', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_config&view=component&component=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-display-options-hierarchy-article-category-menu-item'), 'The author is hidden', '

Look at your site with this button: it opens in a new tab (in the Joomla Playground you can also click Site in its toolbar), or reload that tab.

Click Sundial Software Blog again: the author is gone, in the list and in the articles. Both use the global setting.

Come back to this tab and click Next.
